title: outside a git checkout the project warns, the machine checks still print, the project checks are left out and the exit is 0
source: intended: B4B5-DESIGN.md B4-22 and the doctor spec (defect N-20): a read-only health check
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-20, B4.5; the fail became a warning in v0.1.2). Run from the sandbox HOME (no git checkout) doctor exits 0 and prints `warn project: <dir> is not inside a git checkout; the project checks are skipped`, still prints `ok   binary: ...` and the other machine checks, and prints no line for the project checks (no `catalog:` line). Nothing goes to stderr.

stdout.regex: (?m)^warn project: .* is not inside a git checkout; the project checks are skipped$
